title: Japan 2-Year JGB auction (No.491 inferred) — the 9th of the 12 auctions MOF's FY2026 issuance plan sizes at Y2.8tn, and its announcement cannot fall on the inherited D-7 date
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200, 25,188 bytes) — its table row reads 'Nov. 30, 2026 | 2-year' and all three of the announcement, result and Non-Price-Competitive-II cells are the plain string 'Detail' with no href, so nothing about this auction has been published. Reproduced independently this session across MOF's full published English calendar set 2301e-2611e (47 x HTTP 200; 2201e-2212e and 2612e are 404, a horizon limit, not a block): 47 2-Year rows, 44 held, issue numbers No.445 (2023-01-31) to No.488 (2026-08-28) with ZERO gaps over 3.7 years, one per calendar month, and the Sep. 30 / Oct. 29 / Nov. 30 rows following unnumbered — so '(No.491)' is an INFERENCE on 44 observations, not MOF's print. Filed `estimate` on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office; the date is MOF's own and is not in doubt. Proposed 2026-09-09 by the never-assessed initial research of jgb-2y-auction-2026-10-29; canonical file written 2026-09-10 by this event's own initial research, which reads and shadows that sole proposal
notes: TITLE CORRECTED FROM THE PROPOSAL, which framed this as 'the month-matched control for the 2026-10-29 BoJ-day-one print'. It is not month-matched — the treatment is an October auction and this is a November one — and this session measured what that costs. THE CONTROL IS REAL BUT NEARLY POWERLESS, AND THE ARITHMETIC IS THE FINDING. Re-deriving the family's series independently (all 44 result pages and all 44 announcements fetched direct 2026-09-10, 88 x HTTP 200) reproduces the 10-29 sibling to the decimal — covers 3.876/3.319/3.537/5.244/3.696/4.818/3.626/2.966 for Nos.481-488, day-one cohort mean 3.540 vs near-miss 4.470, exact permutation p = 1/35 = 0.0286. On that same series the proposal's decision rule ('control reads normal = evidence; control reads thin = regime, hypothesis dead') carries a FALSE-KILL RATE OF 34%: 14 of the 41 non-day-one auctions already print cover at or below the day-one mean of 3.540, so an ordinary November print has a one-in-three chance of reading as a regime by chance alone. Two further measurements say the control is answering a question the data does not pose: there is NO time trend in cover (slope 0.0015/auction, permutation p = 0.83) and no recent-window shift (last 3/6/9/12 auctions all within 0.25 of the prior mean; 2026 CY mean 3.885 is ABOVE the pre-2026 3.746), so the 'late-2026 regime' the control exists to rule out is not visible at n = 44. And the calendar-month effect that would justify calling a November print a control at all is absent on this metric: between-month sum of squares over 12 months gives permutation p = 0.63. THE MULTIPLICITY CEILING, WHICH SETTLES THE WHOLE LINE OF WORK: even a PERFECT 2026-10-29 result takes the Jul/Oct cohort to n = 8 with 4 treated, C(8,4) = 70, minimum attainable p = 0.0143 — and Bonferroni over the six comparisons already run gives 0.0857, still short of 0.05. The hypothesis cannot become multiplicity-honest significant until a NINTH Jul/Oct auction exists (C(9,5) = 126, best case 0.0476), which at roughly one collision a year is 2027 at the earliest. This auction is not in the Jul/Oct cohort and enters no permutation test at all. TWO THINGS THIS ENTRY ACTUALLY SETTLES. (1) THE INHERITED ANNOUNCEMENT DATE IS A TOKYO MARKET HOLIDAY. Both the proposal and the 10-29 sibling say terms publish 'about 2026-11-23'; that Monday is Labour Thanksgiving Day and JPX is dark group-wide (this calendar's own jpx-market-closure-2026-11-23 carries the exchange's finalized 'Not Open' row, and JGB futures are ineligible for holiday trading). All 44 announcement leads were parsed this session: D-7 in 41, D-8 in 2, D-10 in 1 — and ALL THREE deviations have one cause, D-7 falling on a Japanese national holiday, with MOF moving EARLIER every time (2023-11-30, D-7 = Labour Thanksgiving, went D-8; 2024-09-30 and 2025-09-30, D-7 = the Autumnal Equinox, went D-10 and D-8). The rule is therefore 44 of 44 with no exceptions once stated correctly: the announcement is the last JGB-market business day on or before D-7. For this auction D-8 is a Sunday and D-9 a Saturday, so that day is FRIDAY 2026-11-20 (D-10) — a date MOF's own November calendar independently proves is a business day by scheduling two other auctions on it. (2) THE OFFERING SIZE IS A PUBLISHED PLAN NUMBER, NOT AN EXTRAPOLATION — this closes the gap the 10-29 sibling named as 'the obvious next piece of work and it is not done here'. MOF's FY2026 JGB Issuance Plan (debt_management/plan/highlight251226.pdf, HTTP 200, 389,290 bytes, fetched direct 2026-09-10) states the 2-Year at 'Y2.8tn x 12 times = Y33.6tn'. Its fiscal-year bucketing was verified rather than assumed: bucketing auctions March-through-next-February reproduces the plan's own FY2025 supplementary total EXACTLY as Y2.6tn x 6 + Y2.7tn x 3 + Y2.8tn x 3 = Y32.1tn, and no other bucketing does. FY2026 therefore runs No.483 (2026-03-31) to No.494 (2027-02), six already executed at exactly Y2,800bn, and THIS AUCTION IS THE 9TH OF THE 12. The sibling's 'medium confidence, a 9-print regime read as a law' becomes high confidence with one named residual risk: a supplementary-budget revision, the mechanism that produced the FY2025 step, and MOF has published no FY2026 revision as of 2026-09-10. A THIRD FINDING IS A CORRECTION THIS LANE CANNOT MAKE IN THE FILE THAT NEEDS IT, so it is recorded here for whoever scores FT-jgb-2y-auction-2026-10-29-4: that test's premise, 'MOF publishes no 2-Year auction outside the final three business days of its month', is ALREADY FALSE 5 times in the 44-print record (2023-12-26 and 2025-12-25 at rank 4, 2024-07-26 at rank 4, 2025-04-24 at rank 4, 2024-04-23 at rank 5). April is the loose month — ranks 3/5/4/1 across 2023-2026 — so the April-2027 collision the sibling forecasts needs rank 2 or 3, which April has hit once in four; the October-2027 collision needs rank 1 or 2, which October has hit twice in three. November, by contrast, is rank 1 in 3 of 3, which is why this auction's month-end placement is the safest thing about it. Also corrected, small and precise: the sibling's 'Y2.8tn-era mean 3.885' is the 2026-CALENDAR-YEAR mean (n = 8); the true Y2,800bn era including No.480 (2025-12-25) is n = 9, mean 3.815. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
